lead.event: DOOH announces an acquisition, rights issue and IPO-fund reallocation
lead.headline: DOOH plans Rp2 trillion INET acquisition, rights issue and IPO-fund reallocation
lead.blurb: Era Media Sejahtera plans to buy 29.88% of INET through Cakrawala Nexus Investama, acquiring 6.68 billion shares at Rp300 each for Rp2 trillion. An initial Rp2 trillion drawdown from a Rp5 trillion, 10-year shareholder loan facility from new controller Sinergi Internasional Investama will fund the purchase at 7.50% annual interest. DOOH also proposes up to 154.77 billion rights shares with Series II warrants and will redirect Rp120 billion of remaining IPO funds to Cakrawala Nexus. Shareholders vote on the actions at an extraordinary meeting on 9 November.

earnings_guidance.event: JPFA, CPIN, MAIN and WMPP report Q3 growth
earnings_guidance.headline: JPFA, CPIN, MAIN and WMPP report Q3 growth, with CPIN profit up 54%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Japfa Comfeed's revenue rose 26% to Rp54.52 trillion and net profit grew 34%; Charoen Pokphand Indonesia's revenue rose 18.9% and net profit reached Rp5.18 trillion. Malindo Feedmill's net profit grew 24.89%, while Widodo Makmur Perkasa returned to profit at Rp103.10 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: DADA reports a sharp Q3 2026 profit increase
earnings_guidance.headline: DADA reports Q3 net profit up 863.76% to Rp8.24 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Diamond Propertindo's net revenue rose 220% to Rp28.96 billion. Shares have fallen 66% from Rp50 on 25 September since the Rp1 share price implementation on 28 September, last trading around Rp17 and hitting the lower price limit in the latest session.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri and BNI report nine-month earnings and subsidiary contributions
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI and BNI report nine-month profits of Rp45.53 trillion and Rp16.11 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s consolidated profit rose 20.68% year on year, with subsidiaries contributing Rp3.07 trillion. BNI’s consolidated profit of Rp16.11 trillion was below its bank-only profit of Rp16.36 trillion as subsidiary fee-based income fell 6.2% to Rp311 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: HRTA reports strong nine-month sales amid weak jewelry demand
earnings_guidance.headline: HRTA reports nine-month sales up 77.38% to Rp44.69 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Hartadinata Abadi’s revenue was supported by bullion products as Indonesian jewelry demand fell 18% year on year to 3.1 tons in Q3. Exports to the United Arab Emirates reached about Rp1.32 trillion, roughly 3% of sales. Adrian Djie recommended buying HRTA with a Rp2,900 target, while Alrich Paskalis Tambolang took a wait-and-see stance.

deals_control.event: Takjub Finansial Teknologi sells a 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.headline: Takjub Finansial sells 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.blurb: It sold 304.92 million shares at Rp777 apiece on 2 November for about Rp236.92 billion. Its ownership fell from 33.45% to 24.45%, and it said it is not BNBA’s controlling shareholder and does not control the bank. The sale was reported to OJK on 5 November, according to an IDX disclosure.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK urges MNC Bank to resolve customer withdrawal problems
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK urges BABP to resolve withdrawal issues, says Rp6 trillion is not a minimum
market_structure_policy.blurb: OJK has asked MNC Bank to provide certainty on customer funds owed and set out steps and schedules to restore transactions and settle pending complaints. It says the bank's condition remains fairly good and its core capital complies with regulations, while capital strengthening remains a priority through possible shareholder injections, strategic investors or consolidation.
